name: switchyard
description: Routes each Claude Code turn and sub-agent to the cheapest sufficient model using a SystemOne decision model

systemone_url.title: SystemOne URL
systemone_url.description: Base URL of a /v1/systemone server, e.g. http://localhost:11434. Blank uses TypeSafe.

systemone_model.title: Decision model
systemone_model.description: Model the SystemOne server runs, e.g. clef-flash. Blank uses jev-latest on TypeSafe.

systemone_key.title: SystemOne API key
systemone_key.description: Bearer key for a server that needs one

timeout_ms.title: Decision timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: 0 uses 3000 for TypeSafe and 8000 otherwise. Capped at 9000.

min_confidence.title: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: Below this the router won't downgrade. 0 uses 0.3 for TypeSafe and 0.1 otherwise.

baseline.title: Savings baseline
baseline.description: usual, opus, or an exact model id

allow_fable.title: Allow the Fable tier
allow_fable.description: Let the router pick the Fable tier for the hardest turns
